s.note: Homemade soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, topped with rock salt
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into pretzels, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.

s.note: Bocconcini with basil and chilli on toothpicks with cherry tomatoes
s.how: Toss 250g bocconcini pearls with olive oil, torn basil and a pinch of chilli flakes and leave for an hour. Thread onto toothpicks with cherry tomatoes. Arrange on a dark plate like a string of stolen pearls and drizzle over the leftover oil.

m.note: Beef meatballs in passata sauce, in toasted long rolls under melted provolone
m.how: Mix 500g beef mince, 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 1 crushed garlic clove and salt, and roll into 16 meatballs. Brown in olive oil, then add 500ml passata, 2 more crushed garlic cloves and a few basil leaves, and simmer 20 minutes. Split and toast 4 long rolls. Fill each with 4 meatballs and sauce, lay over 8 slices of provolone and grill for 2 minutes until melted. Finish with fresh basil.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream drowned in hot espresso, amaretti on the side
w.how: Brew a strong pot of espresso. Put a big scoop of vanilla ice cream into each glass and set out a few amaretti biscuits alongside. At the table, pour a hot shot of espresso over each scoop and eat straight away while it melts.

d.note: Espresso shaken hard with sugar syrup and ice until frothy
d.how: Brew 8 shots of espresso, or 320ml very strong coffee. Make a syrup by dissolving 2 tbsp caster sugar in 2 tbsp hot water. For each drink, add 2 shots of coffee and 2 tsp syrup to a shaker full of ice and shake very hard for 15 seconds until thick and foamy. Strain into a chilled martini or wine glass and twist a strip of lemon peel over the top.
